High torque impact wrench with variable 3-speed and reverse control. Lightweight design offers ease of use in confined areas and ½" square drive with detent pin aids rapid socket changes. Offers up to 950Nm fastening torque. Features all-metal gearing, rubber 'XR' overmould grip and LED work light with brightness control.
